categories.main_business_segments: TechnipFMC operates through two main business segments: Subsea and Surface Technologies. The Subsea segment provides integrated design, engineering, procurement, manufacturing, installation, and life-of-field services for subsea systems and infrastructure used in offshore oil and gas production. The Surface Technologies segment designs, manufactures, and services products and systems for land and shallow water exploration and production, including wellheads, pressure control, and flowline equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include proprietary subsea production systems, flexible and rigid pipelines, umbilicals, subsea robotics (e.g., GEMINI ROV), and digital platforms like Subsea Studio™. The company emphasizes modular, pre-engineered architectures (Subsea 2.0 CTO), advanced automation, digitalization, and LEAN manufacturing practices to drive efficiency and standardization across both segments.
categories.primary_customers_markets: TechnipFMC's primary customers are major integrated oil companies, national oil companies, independent exploration and production companies, and oilfield service companies. Key end markets include offshore deepwater oil and gas developments (Subsea) and onshore/unconventional oil and gas production, as well as emerging markets in carbon capture, hydrogen, and offshore renewables.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally, with significant presence in Europe (UK, Norway, France, Netherlands), North and South America (US, Brazil, Guyana), Africa (Nigeria, Angola, Ghana), the Middle East (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar), and Asia-Pacific (India, Malaysia, Australia, Singapore). In 2022, approximately 80% of revenue was generated outside the United States.
categories.supply_chain_position: TechnipFMC is primarily a midstream and downstream technology and service provider, delivering engineered systems, project management, and field services directly to oil and gas operators. The company also acts as a system integrator for complex offshore and energy transition projects, spanning from concept to project delivery and life-of-field support.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include driving innovation in integrated subsea solutions (iEPCI), digitalization, automation, and standardization (Subsea 2.0 CTO), as well as expanding into energy transition markets such as carbon capture, offshore renewables, and hydrogen. R&D efforts focus on reducing project costs, improving efficiency, enabling all-electric fields, and developing new technologies for both traditional and new energy applications.
categories.revenue_model: TechnipFMC generates revenue primarily through long-term contracts for project delivery, product sales (engineered systems and equipment), services (installation, maintenance, digital solutions), and leasing of specialized vessels and equipment. Revenue is recognized over time for most project-based contracts and at a point in time for standardized product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In Subsea, key competitors include Aker Solutions, Baker Hughes, SLB, Subsea 7, McDermott, and Oceaneering. In Surface Technologies, competitors include Baker Hughes, Halliburton, SLB, Cactus, and SPM Oil & Gas. TechnipFMC differentiates itself as the only fully integrated provider offering the complete suite of subsea production equipment, installation, and life-of-field services, and is a market leader in several Surface product lines.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, TechnipFMC reported $6.7 billion in revenue, with Subsea accounting for $5.5 billion and Surface Technologies $1.2 billion. The company saw a 4.6% year-over-year revenue increase and a 36% increase in Subsea inbound orders, reflecting a strong growth trajectory driven by offshore market recovery and expansion into new energy markets. Order backlog at year-end was $9.4 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: TechnipFMC emphasizes its ability to deliver integrated, technologically differentiated solutions that improve project economics, accelerate time to first production, and reduce emissions. Its unique iEPCI model, digital platforms, and configure-to-order product architecture enable clients to achieve lower costs, greater efficiency, and enhanced performance, positioning the company as a key enabler of both conventional and energy transition projects.
